subject: Nov 30–Dec 2 Redwood / LumenHealth workshop — cross-region call slots & travel coordination
messages:
From: Naomi Feldman <naomi.feldman@redwood.ai>
To: Erin Clarke <erin.clarke@lumenhealth.com>, Daniel Gomez <daniel.gomez@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 15 Nov 2026 08:12:00 -0800
Subject: Nov 30–Dec 2 Redwood / LumenHealth workshop — cross-region call slots & travel coordination

Hi Erin / Daniel —

Excited to firm up logistics for the in-person workshop at Redwood (Nov 30–Dec 2). We want to make sure multi-region attendees have clear calendar holds and that travel arrival/departure windows are aligned with the rehearsal and exec session. Quick asks to confirm so we can finalize calendar holds this week: 

1) Preferred arrival window for your execs (local time): morning of Nov 30 vs afternoon of Nov 29?
2) AV and room needs: will you need a dedicated video bridge for EU participants (CET) and an extra laptop input for on-stage demos?
3) Headcount per day (onsite vs virtual) — helps with catering and badges.

Proposed cross-region blocks (we'll publish as calendar-holds once we lock):
- Option A: 08:30–12:30 PST / 17:30–21:30 CET / 22:00–02:00 IST (good for US morning + EU overlap)
- Option B: 12:00–16:00 PST / 21:00–01:00 CET / 01:30–05:30 IST (better for US late morning + APAC night)
- Option C: Hybrid staggered sessions (US/EU morning local + a separate APAC sync) — more complexity, but doable.

Attachments: Redwood_Lumen_Agenda_v1.pdf (draft), travel_options_nov30.xlsx (travel windows & hotel picks).

If you can reply with arrival preference and headcount by EOD Tue (Nov 17), we will lock holds and loop in our travel partner for quotes. Monica will be on-site lead; Rishi is PM for the engagement. Jordan will coordinate room AV and slides.

Thanks —
Naomi
Naomi Feldman
Account Lead, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
naomi.feldman@redwood.ai | +1 415-555-0173

From: Erin Clarke <erin.clarke@lumenhealth.com>

Date: Mon, 16 Nov 2026 11:04:00 +0000
Subject: Re: Nov 30–Dec 2 Redwood / LumenHealth workshop — cross-region call slots & travel coordination

Thanks Naomi — this looks good. Quick responses: 

1) Arrival: Our execs prefer afternoon of Nov 29 (arrive late afternoon / early evening) so they have a full day on Nov 30. If flights are constrained, morning Nov 30 is okay for the working group.
2) AV: Yes please — we'll want a dedicated video bridge for CET folks and a redundant HDMI input for demos. Also one lapel mic + room mic.
3) Headcount: Day 1 (Nov 30): 14 onsite + 6 virtual. Day 2: 12 onsite + 4 virtual (execs will join for the PM session). Day 3: 8 onsite + 2 virtual.

We'd like Redwood to arrange hotel pickups for our execs (SFO), and we can share arrival times once flights are booked. I'll loop procurement if you need a PO for travel.

Appreciate the proposed blocks — Option A looks best for us.

Best,
Erin
Erin Clarke
Director, Partnerships — LumenHealth
erin.clarke@lumenhealth.com | +44 7700 111222

Erin — great, thanks for the quick answers. Noted: Option A and arrival on Nov 29 for execs. Action items from Redwood side: 

- I'll publish calendar-holds for Nov 29 (late afternoon welcome), Nov 30 full day, Dec 1 full day, Dec 2 half day. Holds will include PST / CET conversions and a Zoom link for EU virtual attendees.
- Monica will be the on-site coordinator — she'll collect dietary restrictions/badges and will own AV run-of-show.

I'll have the first draft of the holds and invites out by Wed morning PST.

—Rishi

Hi all —

Thanks for the ping. Attached is a quick quote matrix (tripcorp_quote_4567.pdf) and a sample itinerary. High-level notes: 
- We can guarantee hotel pickups at SFO for arrivals between 15:00–22:00 local time — includes black car for execs.
- For CET travelers we recommend an overnight flight arriving Nov 29 late evening or an early morning Nov 30 flight — red-eye cushion is doable but adds ~$250 per pax.
- Estimated per-person travel + transfer (roundtrip economy + transfers): $980–$1,450 depending on routing.

Let me know headcount and we’ll produce a PO-ready quote. We can also create calendar-friendly .ics with ETA that your teams can drop into invites.

Regards,

ely@tripcorp.com | +1 415-555-0145

Naomi
